question: What becomes fit for meditation in this system of manifestation?
premises: By its own will and by the force of the nature of creation, consciousness manifests a sense-object in front.
Whatever sense-object is thus manifested becomes available for meditation.
Meditation is grounded in what is freely manifested, not in an abstract formlessness alone.
inference: Any sense-object freely manifested by the creative nature of consciousness is fit to serve as an object of meditation.
plain_english: Whatever sense-object consciousness creates before itself by its own will and by the force of its creative nature becomes fit for meditation on that very object.
